info.name: blogapp
info.description: ## Overview The **blogapp API** provides endpoints for managing users, categories, posts, and comments for a blogging platform. It covers typical CRUD operations and basic querying, such as: - User management (registration, login, profile, updates, deletion) - Category management (create, update, delete, list) - Post management (create, update, delete, list, filter by user or category) - Comment management (create and list comments on posts) This collection is intended for development and testing within the team. It uses the **dev** environment for configuration and authentication. --- ## Getting Started ### 1\. Select the environment 1. In Postman, open the collection: [blogapp](https://collection/19697234-e9c952e2-7e2e-4cb0-80c0-b927650ee618). 2. In the top-right environment dropdown, select **dev**: [dev](https://environment/19697234-c1db4360-3995-4d4c-975b-2ce235ab5eb3). 3. Ensure that the base URL and other variables (e.g. `{{base_url}}`, `{{token}}`) are correctly set in the **dev** environment. Typical environment variables (example): - `base_url` – e.g. `http://localhost:9090/api` - `token` – JWT or access token used for Bearer authentication - Any additional variables specific to your API (e.g. `userId`, `postId`, `categoryId`) > Note: Adjust the variable names above to match your actual environment definition. --- ### 2\. Authentication Most protected endpoints expect a **Bearer token** in the `Authorization` header. In this collection, we use the environment variable `{{token}}`: \`\`\`http Authorization: Bearer {{token}}
